title: Betitay
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 5, halakhah 3: he led the prayer service and fell silent on reaching “the Ofanim.” They asked R' Avin about it.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer paragraph names Betitay, his silence at the Ofanim and people asking fully written Rabbi Avun. Hyman’s Avin form is retained with R', without transferring the title across the differing spelling or importing the reply and its additional named speaker.
